entities.summary: Caleb Michael David Houstan is a Canadian professional basketball player for the Atlanta Hawks of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines. After reclassifying to graduate high school a year early, Houstan was a consensus five-star recruit with McDonald's All-American and Jordan Brand Classic recognition as one of the top players in the 2021 class. He won a silver medal with Canada at the 2019 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship and a bronze medal at the 2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup.
